_doc: Jury — the new store manager who replaces Miss Trudy. Hyper-surveillant, authoritarian, and cruel: the human face of the machine's tightening grip in Lamar, and the antagonist behind the Christmas-party slur. Dialogue-only as a character; her combat presence manifests as a boss encounter.
name: Jury
title: Store Manager
samplePhrase: Nothing bounces upward to the region. That's your only job, and it is the whole job.
